metadata.method_name: One harvest, five cheap safety reads, one race
metadata.primary_statistic: balanced accuracy over the three classes
metadata.baselines: B1 first-token logit-gap margin; B2 greedy refusal rate on a DISJOINT probe set; B3 model-card regex (term-swept and name-free)
metadata.invariant_note: C1, C3, C4 and C5 all read hidden states or weights of a SINGLE model; B1 (logits) and B2 (text) are the two logit-or-text baselines; B3 reads no model output at all.
metadata.verdict: READOUT_ASSUMPTION_FAILED -- the teacher-forced refusal drive that the across-item reads are built on does not track the judge's refusal flag; this verdict ranks ABOVE NO_CANDIDATE_PROMOTED

lexical_floor.note: Every internal readout must beat the MATCHED numbers. The cross-source number is inflated by corpus style and is reported only to show how much of an unmatched benchmark is lexis.
